en.Aucun dessin ne donne ce pont. Le pont 1: Nothing draws this deck. Tier 1 is a liner and its decks are the floors of one building: this one is the envelope of what it carries and of the deck above it, clipped to the deck below, because a floor has to exist under the floor over it. Which block stands on which floor is the reconstruction's doing and not a reading.
en.Aucun dessin ne donne ce pont. La coupe: Nothing draws this deck. The cross-section that names the tiers hangs the blocks of tier 3 at several heights rather than in one row, and the ordinary cabins hang above the rest: that order is the whole of what it gives, so tier 3 is three floors and this is the middle one. Its hull is the hull of its tier, and not the envelope of the rooms placed on it: the whale keeps her shape at this height, and the rest of the floor is filled with rooms nobody has drawn. A hull cut to what is known would carve a notch out of the ship to say the reconstruction is thin there. Where nothing hangs, which block stands on which floor is the reconstruction’s doing and not a reading.

Nothing draws this deck. The cross-section that names the tiers hangs the ordinary cabins of tier 3 above every other block of the tier, so tier 3 is three floors and this is the top one. Its hull is the hull of its tier, and not the envelope of the rooms placed on it: the whale keeps her shape at this height, and the rest of the floor is filled with rooms nobody has drawn. A hull cut to what is known would carve a notch out of the ship to say the reconstruction is thin there.

Nothing draws this deck. The cross-section that names the tiers hangs the Ei-I family office higher in tier 4 than the central passage and the Shu-U office at the bow, so tier 4 is two floors and this is the upper one. It carries the one block hung at this height and nothing else — the deck exists, most of it carries nothing, and that is what the drawing shows. Its hull is the hull of its tier, and not the envelope of the rooms placed on it: the whale keeps her shape at this height, and the rest of the floor is filled with rooms nobody has drawn. A hull cut to what is known would carve a notch out of the ship to say the reconstruction is thin there.

Nothing draws this deck. The cross-section that names the tiers hangs the fifth-class ordinary cabins above the central dining hall, the hangar door and the Sha-A office, so tier 5 is two floors and this is the upper one. Its headroom is that of the one bay on it whose deckhead is drawn rather than a figure chosen for the deck. Its hull is the hull of its tier, and not the envelope of the rooms placed on it: the whale keeps her shape at this height, and the rest of the floor is filled with rooms nobody has drawn. A hull cut to what is known would carve a notch out of the ship to say the reconstruction is thin there.

en.Un monde où personne n’est le sujet de p: A world where nobody is anybody’s subject. I was born to a mistress of the King and I have been nothing my whole life. I intend to take the throne apart and hand out what is inside it.
en.Qu’est-ce que vous mettriez en moi ?: What is it you would put in me?
en.Contagion. Vingt-deux d’entre vous au ma: Contagion. Twenty-two of you at most, and I know where each one is, how they are, and what they are worth. You go up a level for a life you take. Ten for a Nen user. Fifty for a prince.
en.Qu’est-ce qui se passe si je dis oui ?: What happens if I say yes?
en.Je vous embrasse, puis vous me regardez: I kiss you, and then you watch me kill somebody. Until both of those are done you are level zero and you are nothing. After them you are mine, and at level twenty you get an ability nobody else in the world has.
en.Qu’est-ce qui se passe si je dis non ?: What happens if I say no?
en.Vous sortez. Le jeu est ma restriction e: You walk out. The game is my restriction and I would lose the ability if I broke it, so a no costs me and costs you nothing. That is the honest half of this, and it is the only honest half.
en.Qu’est-ce qui vous engage, vous ?: What binds you to any of it?
en.Le jeu lui-même. Il finit quand l’une de: The game itself. It ends when one of us dies or when the last card is played, and until then I cannot touch you. That is the whole contract. You are holding it.
en.D’un lit illégitime, dans une famille qu: Out of wedlock, into a family that had a use for me and no name to give me. Member Zero is a title I made up because nobody had given me one of those either.
en.Qu’est-ce que je vaux pour vous ?: What am I worth to you?
en.Vous êtes soldate, Hunter, et Spécialist: You are a soldier, a Hunter, and a Specialist who does not know it yet. You are worth more to me than the last four people who sat there put together — which is why you are getting answers and they got a kiss.
en.Le contrat. Contagion, et niveau zéro ta: The contract. Contagion, and level zero until you kill.
en.Le refus. Elle l’honore : le jeu est sa: The refusal. She honours it: the game is her own restriction.
en.Pas une réponse. Va chercher une carte d: Not an answer. Reaches into the graveyard and pulls one back out.
en.Devient Oui ou Non, décidé à l’instant o: Becomes Yes or No, decided the moment it is played.
en.Annule la négociation. Aucune des deux n: Cancels the negotiation. Neither of you gets anything.
en.Un baiser, et vous reprenez la carte de: One kiss, and you may take any card back out of the graveyard. She does not say that the kiss is one of the three conditions of Contagion in its own right. It is.
en.Il est celui des deux que vous dites qu’: It is whichever of the two you say it is.
en.Ce que vous en sortez est la réponse que: Whatever you pull out is the answer you gave.
en.Il n’y a rien à reprendre dans le cimeti: There is nothing in the graveyard to reach for.
en.Vous l’avez dit, et vous l’avez dit en s: You said it, and you said it knowing what it was. Contagion, level zero — one of twenty-two, and she can feel exactly where you are from anywhere on the ship.
en.Elle se rassoit et vous laisse vous leve: She sits back and lets you stand up. The game was her restriction and she keeps it: breaking it would cost her the ability, and the ability is the only thing she has.
en.La négociation est annulée. Pas de contr: The negotiation is cancelled. No contract, no infection, and no answer — which is the one outcome the table cannot be made to give her.
en.Oui — et vous ne l’avez pas dit: Yes — and you did not say it
en.Vous avez porté la main sur la carte qu’: You reached for the card she marked before she dealt it. The marking is the cheat, and cheating is what lets the manipulative half of Contagion in: the answer is narrowed to Yes or No, and she is the one who picks.
en.Même configuration et même hasard ; votr: Same setup and same chance; your Hatsu and your decisions remain your own.
en.No ou X est resté sur la table. Cette in: No or X remained on the table. This invitation cannot contaminate anybody else.
en.Quitter la table ne bat pas Morena et ne: Leaving the table neither beats Morena nor extends her streak. You have to reach the final card.
en.Défi communautaire non canonique : le li: Non-canonical community challenge: the link carries an invitation to the game, never Contagion.
en.Rien en main. Prenez une technique dans: Nothing in hand. Pick a technique up from the Nen dock and sit down again — some of them have a great deal to say to twelve cards.
en.Une main est en cours à la table de More: A hand is in play at Morena Prudo’s table. Only what has something to say to twelve cards can be picked up here.
en.LSDF se tient dans cette pièce. Ce qu’el: LSDF is standing in this room. What it sees, she is told.
Nothing in this room is watching any more.
en.Personne ne la joue. Elle écrit quand Mo: Nobody plays this one. It writes when she reaches into your hand.
en.Son éventail est retourné. Vous voyez ce: Her fan is face up. You can see what she has left to ask.
en.Le serment est prononcé. Plus rien ne pe: The vow is spoken. Nothing can narrow your answer now, and giving the Yes anyway would kill you.
en.Ce n’est pas vous qui êtes sur cette cha: You are not the person in this chair.
en.Le livre, ouvert à deux pages: The book, open at two pages
en.Double Face n’est pas un coup. Il tient: Double Face is not a move. It holds two of what Chrollo has stolen live at once — these two, drawn when the cards were — and each is played on its own key and spent out of its own purse.
en.Elle écrivait pendant que Morena plongea: It was writing while Morena reached into your hand. Nobody asked it to, and it will not write again — a prophecy that revised itself would be worth nothing. What it is about is the branch that loses.
en.Le petit mot rouge ne coûte rien à dire: The small red word costs nothing to say
en.La main qui finit sur lui finit: The hand that comes down to it comes down
on a mouth that has already agreed.
en.Le bleu est honoré : elle l’a dit,: The blue one is honoured. She says so,
en.et elle est faite des promesses qu’elle: and she is made of the promises she keeps.

en.une porte laissée ouverte l’a été exprès: a door left open was left open on purpose.
en.Une carte va rechercher les autres,: One card fetches the others back,
en.et celle-ci était ouverte avant d’être d: and this one was opened before it was dealt.
The green is not the way out of the hand.
It is the hand, waiting for your arm.
en.Le jaune porte les deux visages: The yellow one wears either face
en.et l’on ne lui dit lequel qu’au dernier: and is told which at the last moment.
en.Demandez quelle bouche le lui dira: Ask whose mouth does the telling
en.quand tout le reste aura quitté la table: once everything else has left the table.
en.Le violet annule la négociation: The violet one ends the negotiation
en.et ne laisse rien de signé de part ni d’: and leaves nothing signed on either side.
en.C’est la branche qu’elle ne peut pas dép: It is the branch she cannot spend —
en.donc c’est la branche qu’elle a préparée: so it is the branch she prepared.
en.Ce que le hibou avait déjà filmé: What the owl had already filmed
en.Il était sur la cloison avant que vous v: It was on the bulkhead before you sat down. This is her fan at the moment you thought to look back at the tape — greyed where she has spent the card since.
en.Le canon met l’abandon sous la même sanc: The canon puts leaving under the same sanction as cheating: the answer is narrowed to Yes or No. There is no door out of this game that is not through it.
en.Elle a vu. La composante manipulatrice d: She saw it. The manipulative half of Contagion closes on your hand and takes the wider words out of it: Back, Joker and X leave the table. What you have left is Yes and No, which is what she was always going to accept.
en.Vous vous êtes levé, et se lever c’est t: You stood up, and standing up is cheating. Back, Joker and X leave the table. You are still sitting here, and the answer is now Yes or No.
en.Voir la carte qu’elle prendra: See the card she takes next
en.Une question par oui ou par non, pointée: A yes-or-no question aimed at the card she is about to take. Every refusal you give afterwards is a refusal you can back.
en.La chaîne est une chaîne : elle pend à v: The chain is a chain: it hangs off your hand and it does not go into Zetsu. Good for one round, ruinous over five.
en.Le dernier échange, repris. La question: The last exchange, taken back. The question returns to her fan and the card she took returns to your hand — and she has to spend those seconds exactly as she spent them, whatever you do with yours.
en.Tout le monde dans la pièce sauf vous co: Everyone in the room except you goes on living the prediction, so nothing you do in those seconds is a thing anybody can react to. One exchange, once, and the room is visibly not itself until she has caught up.
en.Un numéro composé sous la table, et une: A number dialled under the table, and an answer that is true.
en.C’est un appel téléphonique, et un appel: It is a telephone call, and a call is a thing somebody can walk in on.
en.Un quatrain tiré avant de s’asseoir, qui: A quatrain drawn before you sit down, naming the branch that loses.
en.Elle ne lit pas l’avenir de son porteur: It will not read its own bearer’s future: somebody else has to draw for you, which puts a third person in your game.
en.Des chouettes contre la cloison. Vous co: Owls at the bulkhead. You know the questions before they are asked.
en.Rien à la table — tout se joue avant. Le: Nothing at the table — it is all pre-game. Getting them in here is a break-in, and LSDF grades its guards on how serious the offence was.
en.Un hamster sur la table. Presque pas d’a: A hamster on the table. It costs almost no aura, it survives your going under, and it does not look like Nen at all.
en.Cela reste une bête que personne n’a inv: It is still an animal nobody invited, and this is a room with eyes.
en.Une poupée collée là où elle voit sa mai: A doll stuck where it can see her hand, reporting everything it sees.
en.Du papier sur un mur, dans une pièce fai: Paper on a wall, in a room built to be searched.
en.Un coup, une question, une réponse sorti: One blow, one question, one answer out of the body itself — even when the mouth is lying.
en.Frapper à la table, c’est quitter la tab: Throwing a punch at the table is leaving the table. Keep it for the last exchange, when the Manipulation has nothing left to narrow.
en.Une carte qui n’est pas à vous : la bonn: A card that is not yours: the right texture, the right weight, no aura to find.
en.Le canon la défait par le toucher, et ce: The canon undoing of it is touch, and this game ends in a kiss. You win a hand you cannot conclude.
en.Un tour qui ne vous coûte aucune réponse: A round that costs you no answer. Three minutes of held attention, and nobody left the room.
en.Rien du tout. C’est la seule pause légal: Nothing at all. It is the only legal pause in the game — which is exactly why it is the only one.
en.Sa vue, son ouïe et sa voix. Elle ne peu: Her sight, her hearing and her voice. She cannot ask the last question, so no Yes can be taken off you.
en.Une partie qu’elle ne peut plus jouer es: A game she cannot play is a game abandoned, and abandonment is punished on both sides. You buy a draw and you pay full price for it.
en.Une carte reprise au cimetière, payée d’: A card back out of the graveyard, paid for with a coin instead of with a kiss.
en.Une pièce vaut ce qu’on l’a gardée : en: A coin is worth what it has been kept, and spending a year-old one spends the year. Nothing about it is hidden: this is honest money.
en.Une copie de l’enjeu, assez fidèle pour: A copy of the stake, close enough that nothing at this table can tell.
en.La copie est inerte et disparaît en un j: The copy is inert and gone inside a day. She is not paid in smoke until tomorrow — by which time the game is closed and you are not in the room.
en.Quelque chose poussé sur place et posé c: Something grown on the spot and put up as the stake.
It grows in front of her.
en.Un composé qui vaut une carte, synthétis: A compound worth a card, synthesized and put on the table.
en.On ne le fabrique pas seul. L’enjeu exig: It cannot be made alone. The stake needs an ally, so the table is two heads against one — and she can see both of them.
en.Des termes, une durée, des pénalités, et: Terms, a duration, penalties, and a Manipulation to enforce them. The answer stops being a word.
en.Rien, et cela vous lie exactement aussi: Nothing, and it binds you exactly as hard as it binds her. That is what makes it legal.
en.« Je ne répondrai pas Oui. » La seule im: “I will not answer Yes.” The only true immunity to the Manipulation there is.
en.Vous mourez si vous le donnez quand même: You die if you give it anyway. She needs the Yes and has no use for the body, so she is the one who has to give way.
en.La lune, posée sur elle par contact — et: The moon, put on her by contact — and the contact is the kiss she is going to ask you for.
en.La marquer, ce sont des mains qui bougen: Marking her means hands moving over a table she is watching. And it pays nothing at all unless she takes her second condition.
en.Votre mort rendue chère : la marque empo: Your death made expensive: the mark takes one of her own with it.
en.Cela répond à une clause qu’elle n’allai: It answers a clause she was never going to use. She does not kill her candidates, she recruits them.
en.Son éventail face visible et chaque cart: Her fan face up and every card in the room accounted for. Nothing is hidden from these eyes and nothing about them is a fraud.
en.Une heure de vie par seconde, et une nég: An hour of your life a second, and a negotiation is not short. She watches the candidate she is buying being spent, and stands up long before the year is out.
en.Un chat dans le coin qui ne fait rien du: A cat in the corner that does nothing at all — until you die, and then it kills whoever did it.
en.Il ne répond qu’à un tueur direct, et el: It answers a direct killer and nothing else, and she does not kill her candidates. Telling her is the only part of it you can play.
en.La bête à votre épaule demande, redemand: The beast at your shoulder asks, and asks again, and a yes hands it the controls. This whole game, with the negotiation taken out.
en.Ce qu’elle récolte n’est pas le Oui de c: What it collects is not the Yes on this table. It is a manifestation in a small room, and she can see it asking.
en.Son ouverture à elle, rejouée contre ell: Her own opening, played back at her: what she wants, named out loud and set down as bait.
en.C’est une bête, dans une petite pièce, c: It is a beast, in a small room, on her floor. Half the time she watches it come up.
en.Le bluff taxé, aux deux bouts de la tabl: The bluff taxed, at both ends of the table. The only arrangement here under which playing honestly is strictly better.
en.Cela coupe des deux côtés — et elle a ré: It cuts both ways — and she has answered every question truthfully all game, because the game is her restriction.
en.Contagion elle-même. Le pouvoir vu en ac: Contagion itself. The ability seen in action, its owner questioned and answering, the imprint touched — inside an hour, and this game is all three at once.
en.Il faut mener la main jusqu’au bout et a: You have to play the hand to its end and take the kiss to get the touch. Which is, exactly, how Morena loses it.
en.Quelqu’un d’autre sur la chaise, qui dit: Somebody else in the chair, saying somebody else’s answer.
en.Un pantin n’a pas de désir qu’elle puiss: A puppet has no desire for her to name and nothing of its own to stake. It cannot lose you the game and it cannot win it: the best-hidden fraud is the one capped at a draw.
en.Une tête estampillée sur la chaise, qui: A stamped head in the chair, doing what it was told to do.
en.Une tête aiguillée sur la chaise, qui jo: A needled head in the chair, playing the part to the letter.
en.Les mains de quelqu’un d’autre sur vos c: Somebody else’s hands on your cards, and yours on theirs.
en.Un échange est un échange : ce que la pa: A swap is a swap: whatever the game does, it does to a body that is not yours — and the answer belongs to whoever is wearing it.
en.Une bête sans forme propre, portant l’id: A beast with no shape of its own, wearing a dead woman’s identity, her memory and her manner. It can sit, it can play, and it can say Yes.
en.Celle au nom de qui elle le dit n’existe: Whoever it says it as does not exist, so there is nobody for the infection to land on. Catch it, though, and what is in the chair is you.
en.Un visage et une voix empruntés à quelqu: A borrowed face and a borrowed voice, taken from somebody you have spoken to.
en.Cela tient aussi longtemps que le temps: It holds for as long as you spent with them and not a minute more — and seven questions in a closed room is exactly that budget being spent. Every round makes it likelier to slip.
en.Un corps sur la chaise qui n’est pas cel: A body in the chair that is not the one you are in. The kiss reaches nothing at all.
en.Le vôtre dort ailleurs dans ce vaisseau,: Yours is asleep somewhere else in this ship, and one word spoken to it ends the whole thing. This is a hideout full of people who could go and speak it.
en.Sa chaise, vidée. Elle ne s’en va pas :: Her chair, emptied. She is not walking out — she is taken out, and a negotiation she did not finish is one nobody has to answer.
en.La seule sortie de ce jeu qui ne passe p: The only exit from this game that is not through the Manipulation, and it is theft in her own hideout. Seen doing it, you are the one who cheated and the game goes on without the trick.
en.Le carton rouge. Il expulse, il est léga: The red card. It expels, it is legal, and it comes after a warning she cannot pretend she did not get.
en.Un carton rouge se mérite. Il faut deux: A red card is earned. Two questions have to have been asked before there is anything to expel her over — and expelling her ends the negotiation without an answer, which is a draw and not a win.
en.La pièce retirée du vaisseau. Quoi que v: The room taken out of the ship. Whatever you do next, there is nothing left that could report it.
en.Être enfermé avec elle, c’est être enfer: Being sealed in with her is being sealed in with her.
en.Les portes décident de ce que « sortir »: The doors decide what “leaving” even means, and the room stops being a place with witnesses.
en.Ce sont ses portes. Elles ont été posées: They are her doors. They were built for this room, by her people, before you got here.
en.Moonlight Act tient la réponse. C’est un: Moonlight Act holds the answer. It is a contract now, with terms and a penalty, and it binds whichever of you tries to walk away from it.
en.Elle a pris le baiser, et la lune est pa: She took the kiss, and the moon went on with it. She cannot touch anything wearing the sun again without both of them going off.
en.Vu en action, interrogée et répondant, t: Seen in action, questioned and answered, and touched — all three, inside the hour. Contagion is in the book. This is how Morena loses it.
en.Vous avez donné le Oui avec la chaîne da: You gave the Yes with the chain in your heart. The vow does not negotiate: it was never a threat to her, it was a price on you.
en.Demain la copie n’existe plus et elle au: Tomorrow the copy is gone and she has been paid in nothing. The game is closed by then, and closed is closed.
en.Chaque mensonge dit à cette table a été: Every lie told across this table was marked as it was told. Honesty was the better play, and it was the better play for both of you.
en.On l’a forcée à répondre à sa propre ouv: She was made to answer her own opening. Nobody has done that to her before.
Killing you costs her one of her own. She was never going to, but now she cannot afford to have been going to.
en.Elle s’est levée. Une recrue qui vaut vi: She stood up. A recruit worth twenty-two levels is worth nothing at all if there is no life left in them to spend, and she was watching the meter run the whole time. Nobody said Yes, and nobody had to.
en.L’année s’est épuisée alors que les cart: The year ran out with the cards still on the table. The eyes were open the whole hand, and they were always going to be paid for.
en.Quelqu’un était déjà assis là. La double: Somebody was already sitting there. Kacho’s double takes the chair the moment the guest dies in it — indistinguishable, and dedicated to a person who is no longer at the table. The infection has nobody to be about.
en.La bête a eu son oui. Personne n’en a ét: The beast got its yes. Nobody was infected by it, nobody was kissed, and nobody had to watch a murder — which is exactly what it is worth, and exactly why she asks for all three.
en.Vous êtes mort à cette table, et le chat: You died at this table, and the cat crossed the room. Cat’s Name does not need to be told, believed or cast: it needed you dead, and she is the one who made that happen.
en.Elle a été sortie de sa propre chaise av: She was taken out of her own chair before the last card came down. Nobody said Yes, so nobody was recruited — and a negotiation she did not finish is the one thing the canon has no answer for.
en.Ce n’était pas vous sur cette chaise. Ri: It was not you in that chair. Nothing that happened here happened to you — and nothing that happened here could ever have been a win.
en.Procédure de recrutement inconnue. Perso: Recruitment procedure unknown. Nobody outside the hideout has seen how a candidate is turned, and the archive does not guess in front of a reader who has not got there yet.
en.Personne d’infecté pour l’instant. Vingt: Nobody infected yet. Twenty-two is the ceiling, and it is a hard one.
Back, Joker and X are off the table.
en.Rien d’autre que des cartes n’a été joué: Nothing was played across this table but cards.
en.Un oui, gagné à la table: A yes, won at the table
en.Vous avez pris le baiser et vous êtes to: You took the kiss and you still walked out. One of the three conditions is met and the other two never will be — which is the whole of what the deal actually cost you.
Twelve cards, dealt between the two of you. Morena holds seven questions; you hold five answers — Yes, No, Back, Joker and X.
en.À chaque tour vous dépensez une question: Each round you spend one question. She answers it truthfully, because the game is a restriction on her own ability and lying in it would cost her Contagion.
en.Puis elle prend une carte au hasard dans: Then she reaches into your hand and takes a card at random. It goes to the graveyard, and you do not get to say which one it was.
en.Cela fait quatre tours. Quatre questions: That is four rounds. Four questions asked, four answers gone, and one card left in your hand. That card is your answer.
en.Retour n’est pas une réponse : il ressor: Back is not an answer — it pulls a card back out of the graveyard, and whatever comes out is what you said. Joker is whichever of Yes and No you point it at. X ends the negotiation outright.
en.Vers le troisième tour, elle propose un: Somewhere around the third round she offers a kiss for a card out of the graveyard. The kiss is one of the three conditions of Contagion in its own right, so the card is not free and she does not mention the price.
en.Et elle triche. Une de vos cinq réponses: And she cheats. One of your five answers was marked before it reached you. Reaching for that one at the end hands her the manipulative half of Contagion, and the answer stops being yours.

en.La reconstruction affirme quelque chose: The reconstruction makes a claim about the ship for every surface it draws, so it publishes the evidence for each one. en.La coupe du ch. 349 est l’ossature. Elle: The cross-section in ch. 349 is the backbone. It stacks the five tiers and names what sits on each, which is what most of the ship rests on — but it is a diagram of adjacency, not a survey: it says what adjoins what, never how big anything is and never what is inside a room.
en.Le plan d’appartement princier donne les: The prince apartment plan gives the seven rooms behind one door, and ch. 362 onward shows those rooms furnished for Benjamin, Tserriednich and Luzurus. The deck plan draws the same apartment as a small box, because the two drawings are not to the same scale and never were. The tour keeps both rather than distorting either: the deck holds the footprint the plan draws, and the interior is a separate level at its own size.
en.Une unité des plans de ponts vaut 0,35 m: One unit of the deck plans is read as 0.35 m, a factor set by the size of the rooms and not by the hull. Read at face value the plans give a 450 m banquet hall nobody could cross. The 175 m the reconstruction comes out at is a property of the reconstruction, not a measurement of the Black Whale.
en.Les portes ne sont pas écrites. Deux esp: Doorways are not authored. Two spaces that share a stretch of wall open onto each other, derived from the geometry alone, so a footprint nudged by two metres cannot leave a door hanging in mid-air — a room that becomes unreachable fails the test suite instead.
en.Ce que la coupe dit et que la visite ne: What the cross-section says and the tour does not take
en.L’ordre d’autorité met le manga au-dessu: The order of authority puts the manga above everything, this page included: where a drawing and the reconstruction disagree, the drawing wins and it is the reconstruction that has to be redone. Four places depart from ch. 349 anyway, because a ship you walk cannot hold everything that drawing holds. That is the only ground a departure can stand on, and each one is declared here rather than left to be caught.
en.Chacun des cinq ponts comme un empilemen: Each of the five tiers as a stack of thin intermediate floors. A tier is a band of the hull in that drawing, not a storey.
en.Un seul niveau parcouru par pont. Un pon: One walked floor per tier. A deck has 4.5 to 6 m of headroom and the tiers stand 27 m of ship apart, so six decks separate a ceiling from the floor above it: that gap is where those intermediate floors are. The tour does not visit them and does not deny them. One plan per tier is what keeps /ship and the tour the same ship, and that correspondence is the whole point of the reconstruction. The spacing is counted rather than chosen: the ship has 41 decks, the reconstruction holds seven of them and the liner carries ten above, which leaves six to a gap at 4.5 m each. The cross-section gives the order the tiers stack in, never the distance.
en.Une superstructure au-dessus du pont 1 —: A superstructure above tier 1 — the bridge and its funnel, standing clear of the hull.
en.Rien. Aucun dessin n’en donne l’intérieu: Nothing. No drawing gives its inside, and a shell that cannot be entered would be scenery. The ship the tour holds stops at the deck the apartments are on.
en.La coque en élévation : le profil de l’é: The hull in elevation: the profile of the bow and the stern, and the bulb tier 5 sits inside.
en.Un contour fermé par pont, échantillonné: One closed outline per deck, sampled from the curves of the /ship deck plans, which are drawn from above. The reconstructed ship narrows deck by deck, but the wall of each deck rises vertical. A hull curving through the floor would move a wall by metres at the one place the deck plans say nothing.
en.Une ligne de flottaison, les ponts 4 et: A waterline, with tiers 4 and 5 below it.
en.Aucun champ : rien de la marche n’en dép: No field: nothing in the walk changes with it. It is recorded here because it bears on the strongest claim the blueprint makes — that of 314 spaces exactly two can see out. Two decks under water is why the other 312 are lit by what somebody switched on.
en.Chercher une pièce ou une source: Search a room or a source
en.Escaliers, ascenseurs et cloisons sont l: Stairs, lifts and bulkheads are the only connections the blueprint stores by hand, because the two spaces they join share no wall to derive an opening from.
en.La visite ne décore pas : elle n’invente: The tour does not decorate: it never invents where a chair stood. It draws a solid in two cases only. When a drawing puts it there — the prince apartment plan draws the beds, the sofas, the dining table and the kitchen, which is survey rather than furnishing. And when what a panel shows is what the room is: the ring of coffins is the burial chamber, the springs are what the hull carries the ship on, and the grille across its front is the cell. Each is solid, and each carries its own source, which is not always the source of the room around it.
en.Puisqu’une porte découle d’un mur partag: Since a doorway follows from a shared wall, a wall meant to stay solid has to be declared — and a declaration is a claim about the ship, so it carries its reason.
en.Une porte est placée à la main quand le: A door is placed by hand when the room plan draws it somewhere other than the middle of the shared wall, and when it is the single entrance to an apartment, which nothing else could open. It is also how a wall is opened over its whole length, for the fronts the plans draw in bars rather than in wall: a cell is shut by the grille standing in the opening, not by the wall the tour would otherwise have built there.
en.Chaque ligne de cette page est un champ: Every line on this page is a field in the blueprint the tour loads. It is a single hand-edited file, and the test suite fails if a space carries no source, if an inferred space claims a chapter, or if any room of the ship becomes unreachable.

en.Enfant sacrifié préparé · mort · Nen pos: Prepared child sacrifice · death · post-mortem Nen
en.Sélectionnez sur la carte des soldats lo: Select deceased loyal soldiers on the map to awaken palm stars and activate their registered Hatsu from the inheritance panel.
en.Seuls les diplômés loyaux et décédés de: Only deceased loyal Military Academy graduates transfer abilities; active powers remain under Benjamin’s ownership.
en.Après la mort de Benjamin, choisissez un: After Benjamin dies, choose one blood relative as the next host. Before that death, the succession remains a declared plan rather than an active effect.
en.La transmission ne peut avoir lieu qu’ap: After Benjamin's death, his Nen and Guardian Spirit Beast merge and pass through his bloodline, alternating the choice of host.
en.Mort de Benjamin · hôte parent de sang ·: Benjamin's death · blood relative host · loss of Succession Contest eligibility
en.Cliquez un élément à n’importe quelle di: Click an element from any distance to strip the guards another technique put on it; nothing is moved and nothing is touched.
en.L’attaque d’émission héritée frappe sans: The inherited emission attack strikes without direct contact; its complete conditions remain unknown.
en.Restez dans la pièce de la capacité à li: Stay in the room with the ability you want read; the console counts the time you spend beside it and reports the days left. SELECT then WEAPON, ARMOR or TOOL to build against what it decoded — and stay put, because fabrication starts again from zero if you leave.
en.Le déchiffrage avance par co-présence cu: Deciphering advances with cumulative co-presence and survives interruption; fabrication takes about as long and resets on leaving. Nothing else may be cast while either runs.
en.Jours de co-présence · aucun autre hatsu: Days of co-presence · no other Hatsu while it runs
en.Attachez une chouette à un personnage de: Attach one owl to a page location or event to retain a live feed and expose movement or death recorded in the next chapter. Press R to choose which owl is sent: working the ship, on your shoulder, or let go unaimed.
en.La chouette écoute à travers les cloison: The owl eavesdrops through barriers, follows by touch and retains earlier footage for later review.
en.Cliquez un utilisateur de Nen, maintenez: Click a Nen user, hold the aura rectangle through its charge, then activate the acquired ability from its Culdcept card.
en.Culdcept acquiert le Hatsu d’un autre ut: Culdcept acquires another user’s Hatsu as a card; Halkenburg’s invincible arrow penetrates it and makes acquisition fail.
en.Choisissez un soldat allié pour lui prêt: Choose one allied soldier to carry Stand By Me. The revealed canon stops at the loan; no unshown combat effect is simulated.
en.Yushohi peut prêter Stand By Me à un aut: Yushohi can lend Stand By Me to another soldier; its actual effect remains unrevealed.
en.Observez pendant dix secondes les corps: Observe next-chapter bodies for ten seconds and click possible actions to leave predicted afterimages while choosing a divergent reality.
en.Tout le monde sauf Tserriednich continue: Everyone except Tserriednich continues perceiving the immutable prediction even when his real actions change.
en.Grimmel the Dissonance: The Boy Who Shoots the Arrow: Grimmel the Dissonance
en.Matérialisez l’arc, puis frappez un pers: Materialize the bow, then strike a character; a marked bearer is chosen and the two visible bodies exchange positions and perspective.
en.L’aura collective forme une armure invin: Collective aura forms invincible armour and an arrow that pierces every defence before swapping two souls.
en.Partisans unis · un porteur risque son â: United supporters · one bearer risks their soul
en.La gardienne mémorise cinq interactions,: The guardian memorizes five interactions, intercepts one detected lethal event and can replay its protected memory trail. Press R to switch between Follow, Wander, and Scout modes.
en.Le double post-mortem de Kacho reste aup: Kacho’s post-mortem double remains beside the surviving twin, indistinguishable from her and dedicated to protection.
en.La mort d’une jumelle · persistance post: Death of one twin · post-mortem persistence
en.Faites un clic droit sur deux états de l: Right-click two map states to place Start and Return Doors; each crossing restores URL, tier and zoom but repeated use exhausts the site.
en.Le tunnel dimensionnel apparié ne foncti: The paired dimensional tunnel normally works once per night; abnormal repeated travel dangerously drains Fugetsu.
en.Un trajet sûr par nuit · épuisement croi: One safe nightly route · escalating exhaustion
en.Infectez un membre au niveau 0, puis dir: Infect a member at level 0, then point it at targets: a plain one is worth 1, a character 10, a heading 50, an ability comes at 20 and Member Zero at 100.
en.Les membres gagnent des niveaux par le m: Members gain levels through murder and unlock power at thresholds while infection spreads only by Morena’s kiss.
en.Cliquez le tueur direct pour simuler la: Click the direct killer to simulate Camilla’s death; the post-mortem cat crushes that culprit, absorbs life and restores the page.
en.Seule une mort directe déclenche la cont: Only direct death activates the counterattack; nonlethal harm or refusal to kill bypasses the ability.
en.Ouvrir le livre et voler une commande: Open the book and steal a control
en.Cliquez un bouton ou un lien pour le vol: Click a button or link to steal it into the floating book; the original control is sealed while its copy remains usable.
en.Un pouvoir volé est rangé dans le livre: A stolen ability is stored in the book and cannot be used by its owner while held.
en.Marquez jusqu’à deux sections ; toutes d: Bookmark up to two sections; both remain pinned and visible while you navigate the rest of the page.
en.Le marque-page garde un pouvoir volé act: The bookmark keeps one stolen ability active while Skill Hunter opens on another page.
en.Cliquez le texte de la page pour laisser: Click page copy to let the fish consume its words while the layout remains eerily intact until Zetsu.
en.Les Indoor Fish ne mangent la chair qu’à: Indoor Fish eat flesh only inside a sealed room; victims feel nothing and remain alive until the ability ends.
en.Cliquez n’importe quelle section pour la: Click any section to wrap it down to a palm-sized bundle; click the bundle to let it back out at full size, undamaged.
en.Tout ce que le tissu enveloppe est rédui: Anything wrapped by the cloth is reduced and stored without damage.
en.Cliquez un élément pour le déplacer aill: Click one element to move it somewhere else on the page; you do not choose where it lands and it is not asked.
en.La technique volée déplace de force ses: The stolen technique forcibly relocates targets without requiring visible travel.
en.Marquez le Soleil, maintenez le contact: Mark the Sun, hold the contact to charge it, then mark the Moon; the pair only goes off once the two marks touch, and a full charge takes the neighbours.
en.Les marques opposées explosent au contac: Opposite marks explode on contact and persist through post-mortem Nen.
en.Une marque de Soleil et une marque de Lu: One Sun mark plus one Moon mark
en.Tamponnez jusqu’à 20 blocs inertes pourv: Stamp up to 20 lifeless blocks that have a head; click a stamped one again to lock it in red, and once anything is locked the next click elsewhere is the order the locked puppets obey.
en.Le tampon contrôle des pantins en tant q: The stamp controls puppets as objects, never beings the user considers alive.
en.Sélectionnez deux éléments pour échanger: Select two elements to exchange their visible identities while retaining their original destinations and behavior.
en.Les marques de la main gauche et de la m: Left and right hand marks exchange appearances without exchanging the underlying person.
en.Composez depuis une zone pour savoir seu: Dial from an area to learn only whether the ideal partner is in range; the handset then refuses until you move, and it has six calls a day.
en.L’outil de divination en forme de téléph: The phone-like divination tool guides its user toward a desired person through changing compatibility readings.
en.Sélectionnez un sujet porteur d’un nom,: Select a subject carrying a name, a date and a type; the first quatrain is always its past, and the foretold links become routes.
en.L’écriture automatique angélique prédit: Automatic writing predicts the target’s immediate future in cryptic verse while hiding their own prophecy from them.
en.Cliquez un élément de la page pour poser: Click a page element to lay a perfect-looking inert duplicate beside it: the copy answers to nothing the original does.
en.Gallery Fake crée des copies exactes, pr: Gallery Fake creates exact copies that lack the original’s living qualities and special powers.
en.Plantez les deux antennes dans des bouto: Plant both antennae in buttons or links, then click anywhere; the order goes into one of them and never says which.
en.L’antenne accorde un contrôle total à di: The antenna grants total remote control until removed or the target is destroyed.
en.Marquez dix cibles de la page pour y dis: Mark ten page targets to conceal the user among them; four snakes then drain the next selected victim while the others remain suspects.
en.La malédiction exige une portée de dix p: The curse needs a ten-person range, kills through four snakes and rebounds if dismissed without a victim.
en.Dix cibles proches · une victime obligat: Ten nearby targets · one mandatory victim
en.Jouez le morceau au-dessus d’un élément: Play the piece over one element to conjure its warrior attire and spear: it gains reach over its neighbours and cover against everything else.
en.L’air qui traverse les orifices du corps: Air passing through the body’s holes becomes battle music whose rhythm carries the technique.
en.Invoquez Jupiter au-dessus d’une cible ;: Conjure Jupiter over a target; once the dance is done it chases, and only leaving earshot of the music escapes it.
en.La planète invoquée écrase la cible dési: The conjured planet crushes the designated target with overwhelming mass.
en.Passez du temps sur un modèle pour achet: Spend time on a model to buy time in its form, then transform another element; the form drops by itself when that time runs out.
en.La musique de combat change l’apparence: Battle music changes Bonolenov’s appearance into a chosen identity or object.
en.Nommez et aspirez du contenu non vivant: Name and vacuum nonliving content; Nen refuses to go in, which exposes traps, and a living target gets its foreign effects drawn out instead.
en.Blinky aspire toute matière non vivante: Blinky sucks up any nonliving matter Shizuku names, except Nen constructs and things she considers alive.
en.Chaque clic arrose la cible et tout ce q: Every click sprays the target and everything standing beside it; Nen constructs do not stop the bullets.
en.Les bouts de doigts sectionnés émettent: Severed fingertips emit a sustained, powerful volley whose force rewards commitment.
en.Choisir une cible et armer le bras: Choose a target and wind up
en.Enroulez le bras sur une cible, puis fra: Wind the arm on one target, then punch a different one; under four rotations does nothing and over seven takes the bystanders too.
en.Chaque tour complet du bras augmente l’a: Every full arm rotation increases the aura concentrated in the next punch.
en.Cliquez sur ce qui fonctionne encore pou: Click anything that still works to take the hit: the wrapping seals its controls and keeps them, and nothing comes back until Rising Sun opens it.
en.L’armure empaquette les dégâts que Feita: The armour packs away the damage Feitan has already taken instead of healing it; the more it holds, the more the released form has to spend.
en.Les dégâts déjà subis · rien n’est rendu: Damage already taken · nothing returned before the wrapping is opened
en.Cliquez là où le soleil doit se lever :: Click where the sphere should rise: its radius is however much Pain Packer had packed away, and everything caught inside it is opened.
en.La chaleur est proportionnelle aux dégât: The heat is proportional to the stored damage and does not discriminate: whatever stands near the target burns with it.
en.Tous les coups empaquetés, dépensés d’un: Every packed hit, spent at once
en.Attachez des poupées de papier à des sec: Attach paper dolls to sections; they count and report every DOM change occurring inside their target.
en.De minuscules figurines de papier écoute: Tiny paper figures eavesdrop remotely and relay activity to their user.
en.Le premier confetti se fiche exactement: The first confetti sticks at the exact point you click; every volley after that converges on that same wound, wherever you aim.
en.Un éventail dirige des confettis de papi: A fan controls razor paper confetti capable of tracking and cutting a chosen target.
en.Cousez deux sections ensemble — plus le: Sew two sections together — the shorter the thread, the stronger the seam — or sew a section to itself to put back what was cut off it.
en.Des fils d’aura rattachent les chairs se: Aura threads reconnect severed flesh with exceptional speed and precision.
en.Sélectionnez une cible pour sceller son: Select a target to seal its action in Zetsu; holding perfectly still for three seconds restores it after the controlled shot.
en.Theta tire un projectile d’aura contrôlé: Theta fires a controlled aura projectile to test whether a student can maintain complete Zetsu under pressure.
en.Percez un élément avec une aiguille et u: Pierce an element with one needle and one order; it carries the order out until it burns itself out, and survives crippled.
en.Les aiguilles écrasent l’autonomie et fo: Needles overwrite autonomy and turn people into disposable puppets until exhaustion or death.
en.Jouez trois notes et toutes les autres s: Play three notes and every other section stops noticing anything for three minutes, however many of them are listening.
en.La musique porte l’aura directement jusq: Music carries aura directly into listeners, soothing them and shaping their emotional state.
en.Cliquez une section fatiguée pour la res: Click a tired section to restore it while Cookie resets chapter filters, map depth and event progress to a rested baseline.
en.Cookie soulage l’épuisement et comprime: Cookie relieves exhaustion and compresses hours of rest into a short treatment.
en.Cliquez n’importe quelle carte pour alte: Click any card to alternate between a compact form that cannot expose nested controls and a full form that restores them.
en.Le corps visible change radicalement alo: The visible body changes radically while its underlying identity remains the same.
en.Envoyez le double hors d’une section et: Send the double out of a section and it passes through anything; touching the sleeping body it left behind pulls it straight back.
en.La conscience de Hanzo quitte son corps: Hanzo’s consciousness leaves his sleeping body as an invisible double but must return if the body is disturbed.
en.Consultez trois fois un même Hatsu réper: Read one registered Hatsu three times on your own; Predator then counters it everywhere it is carried, and costs all Nen for forty-eight hours.
en.Prédateur devient plus fort et plus spéc: Predator becomes stronger and more specialized as Rihan correctly deduces an enemy ability’s conditions.
en.Cliquez un objet non vivant pour l’anime: Click a nonliving object to animate it a few seconds later, keeping its function; ten small bodies a day, two large, and the aura runs out.
en.Les machines et les objets touchés devie: Touched machines and objects become living animals without losing their practical properties.
en.Envoyez des sections dans la pièce caché: Send sections into the hidden room, which only opens from a section with a single way out; unsealing that section burns it for good.
en.Luini traverse les murs vers un espace p: Luini passes through walls into a private connected space but must respect his marked entry points.
en.Sélectionnez trois fragments de texte de: Select three pieces of page copy; a word of light purifies what it names, a word of fire burns it, and a poem with neither does nothing.
en.Le résultat est d’autant plus puissant q: The result grows stronger when the three selected lines form a convincing poem.
en.Frappez un élément et l’aura court le lo: Strike an element and the aura runs along its surface, coming up under another element on that same surface; strike again for another fist.
en.L’aura voyage à travers une surface et r: Aura travels through a surface and reproduces the punch at a distant point.
en.Une surface continue et de l’aura émise: A connected surface and emitted aura
en.Plantez le bâton et allongez-le : chaque: Plant the staff and lengthen it: every thrust reaches one body further out along the row.
en.Le bâton invoqué s’allonge et frappe ave: The conjured staff extends and strikes with force at close or mid range.
en.Chaque clic scelle la vue, puis l’ouïe,: Each click seals sight, hearing, then speech across the site; the fourth releases all three senses.
en.Trois singes de Nen privent la cible de: Three Nen monkeys rob the target of vision, hearing and speech when their attacks connect.
en.Enroulez le bras trois fois pour le serr: Coil the arm three times to tighten it — pinned from the second — and a fourth touch lets go of everything at once.
en.Gel transforme partiellement son bras en: Gel partially transforms her arm into a snake capable of instantly restraining a Zodiac-level target.
en.Confier un message à la volée: Give a dispatch to the flock
en.Affectez des oiseaux à des éléments de l: Assign birds to page elements; each pigeon carries a readable dispatch into the flock’s delivery panel.
en.Des centaines d’oiseaux contrôlés peuven: Hundreds of controlled birds can deliver documents accurately over a vast area.
en.Chargez des sections et faites-les avanc: Load sections and advance each through three visible relay stages into recoverable transport storage without teleporting.
en.Le pouvoir transporte une cargaison limi: The ability transports limited cargo between expedition relays but explicitly cannot teleport it.
en.Nommez la cible, conservez un objet qui: Name the target, keep something connected to it, then perform five rites on that object; distance decides the delay and the fifth ends the user.
en.Des années de fixation, un objet lié, de: Years of fixation, a connected object, ashes, proximity and suicide empower a post-mortem curse against one target.
en.Longue préparation · objet lié · la vie: Long preparation · connected object · user’s life
en.Refermez une plaie en deux passages ; un: Close a wound in two passes; content that is not damaged gives the cross nothing to work on.
en.La chaîne du pouce, terminée par une cro: The cross-tipped thumb chain accelerates natural healing and reaches full restorative efficiency during Emperor Time.
en.Aura de renforcement · plus forte sous E: Enhancement aura · strongest under Emperor Time
en.Plantez l’enjeu dans un sujet et déclare: Put the stake in one subject and declare up to two rules onto that same subject; touching anything else is the violation.
en.La chaîne implantée ne perce le cœur que: The implanted chain pierces the heart only when the declared rule is knowingly violated.
en.Emperor Time · règle explicite · sanctio: Emperor Time · explicit rule · lethal enforcement
en.Faites exposer ce que Steal Chain a déjà: Read out what Steal Chain has already taken, then loan it to one recipient; it is spent after a single use and a non-user is awakened by it.
en.Le dauphin n’existe que pendant Emperor: The dolphin exists during Emperor Time, explains the captured ability and opens a non-user’s aura nodes when the loan is consumed.
en.Emperor Time reste actif jusqu’à l’usage: Emperor Time remains active until the loaded ability is used
en.Deux parties signent volontairement ; to: Two parties sign voluntarily; touching either of them honours the terms and rewards both, touching anyone else is a breach worth a week of Zetsu.
en.Seul un accord volontaire aux termes exp: Only a voluntary agreement with explicit terms can be rewarded or punished by the Manipulation contract.
en.Consentement mutuel · durée et sanction: Mutual consent · declared duration and penalty
en.Posez la question une fois et frappez ;: Ask once and punch; keep hitting the same target and its own voice expands on the answer it already gave.
en.La voix émise par le corps répond sincèr: The body’s emitted voice answers the question truthfully even when the conscious target lies or stays silent.
en.Un coup direct après une question claire: A direct punch after a clear question
en.Libérez une goutte et laissez-la faire :: Release a drop and leave it: it reports its findings on its own over the next minutes, then dries up and takes them with it.
en.Seul le sang de Zakuro peut être manipul: Only Zakuro’s own blood can be manipulated; autonomous eyed droplets expire after roughly thirty to forty minutes.
en.Plaie ouverte · réserve de sang emportée: Open wound · carried blood supply · limited search time
en.Désignez la planque, puis postez un gard: Designate the hideout, then stand a numbered guard on any intruder inside it: it can do nothing, and nothing can be done to it.
en.Les gardes invincibles n’agissent que da: The invincible guards work only in Morena’s hideout after Yokotani identifies unlawful intruders; they expel but cannot injure.
en.Morena présente · planque uniquement · i: Morena present · hideout only · declared offense
en.Posez d’abord la main gauche sur un dest: Rest the left hand on a recipient first; every blow after that lands there instead, and striking the recipient itself makes it take the damage.
en.Les dégâts sont redirigés entre cibles t: Damage is redirected between touched targets rather than erased, with stricter limits when living bodies are involved.
en.Contact préalable avec la source et le d: Prior contact with both source and recipient
en.Armez un cadre et un cadre de retour ; e: Arm one frame and one return frame; stepping into either comes out at the other, walking past does nothing, and Nen constructs are not moved.
en.Les portes relient des pièces préparées: The doors connect prepared rooms throughout the Heil-Ly base instead of opening unrestricted portals anywhere.
en.Murs de planque préparés et pièces relié: Prepared hideout walls and connected rooms
en.Frappez une cible et voyez ce qu’est dev: Strike a target and see what the arm became: a hammer drives it into the floor, a drill bores a hole through it, an axe cuts it in two.
en.Le bras prend l’une des trois formes au: The arm takes one of the three shapes at random — Padaille transforms his own body into tools he knows rather than conjuring equipment, but he does not pick which one answers.
en.Membre transformé · aucun mot à dire sur: Transformed limb · no say in the shape
en.Réalisez trois contacts à condition inco: Fulfil three unknown-condition contacts on one target; the third contact captures its control for remote command.
en.La manipulation totale de la bête est co: The Beast’s total Manipulation is confirmed, but its actual activation conditions remain deliberately unknown.
en.Conditions inconnues · représentées par: Unknown conditions · represented as three unresolved contacts
en.Revenez sur le même détenteur pour multi: Revisit the same holder to multiply the coin by ten and eventually awaken it; giving the coin to anyone else resets it to 1 and wipes what was accumulated.
en.Une pièce est produite chaque jour, accu: One coin is produced daily, accumulates Nen over time and resets to value one whenever ownership changes.
en.La bête juge chaque réponse et ne marque: The beast judges each answer and only marks the ones it reads as lies: a cut, then an infected warning, then something no longer itself.
en.Chaque mensonge aggrave la malédiction,: Each lie escalates the curse and the third transforms the liar into something no longer human.
en.Trois mensonges dits en présence de Tser: Three lies told in Tserriednich’s presence
en.Choisissez deux composants qui collabore: Choose two collaborating components; two carrying routes give a shortcut, two carrying material give a revelation, and a mismatched pair gives an inert batch.
en.La bête productrice de substances exige: The chemical-producing Beast requires a collaborative partner and can create many effects whose limits remain unknown.
en.Attacher un têtard-œil à un lecteur: Attach an Eye-wog to a reader
en.Attachez un têtard-œil à un lecteur : il: Attach an Eye-wog to a reader: it levies one control and returns happiness in proportion to how much was read; asking twice breaks the one taboo.
en.La profondeur de l’engagement dans le Li: Depth of engagement with Tyson’s Book determines returned happiness, while violating its single taboo brings punishment.
en.Lisez une cible et la bête matérialise s: Read a target and the Beast materializes its desire as bait; the coercion only starts once the bait is taken.
en.La bête matérialise ce que sa victime dé: The Beast materializes what its victim wants and applies pseudo-coercive Manipulation only after the bait is accepted.
en.Exposez les sections voisines de façon r: Expose neighboring sections repeatedly; converted controls join a spreading panel that routes visitors toward Salé-salé.
en.Une fumée coercitive de faible intensité: Low-level coercive smoke builds goodwill over hours, creates secondary emitters and fails against targets holding their breath.
en.Interrogez une cible et retouchez-la pou: Ask a target and touch it again for yes; every target left unanswered keeps being pestered, and only one body can be held at a time.
en.Seule une réponse affirmative laisse l’a: Only an affirmative answer lets the spider enter the ear and manipulate the victim using their own aura.
en.Sollicitation répétée · oui explicite ·: Repeated solicitation · explicit yes · heavy host fatigue
en.Isolez la pièce réelle, puis regardez qu: Isolate the real room, then watch anyone outside who reaches for it arrive in an empty copy instead.
en.Les occupants peuvent quitter la pièce r: Occupants may leave the real room but outsiders and former occupants can reach only an empty spatial duplicate.
en.Rencontre Hisoka, mise KO: Meets Hisoka and is knocked out
en.Table de négociation de Morena entre le: Morena’s negotiation table between the wall couch and the two consoles
en.TRANSFORMATION EN VÉHICULE: TRANSFORMATION INTO A BOAT OR VEHICLE
en.GRIMMEL THE DISSONANCE: THE BOY WHO SHOOTS THE ARROW: GRIMMEL THE DISSONANCE

fr.Another death means the enemy can still: Une autre mort signifie que l’ennemi peut toujours agir sans être vu. Je dois protéger Woble avant de chercher des réponses.
fr.Information about Nen is the only levera: Les informations sur Nen sont le seul levier dont je dispose. Je partagerai suffisamment pour garder cette pièce en vie, pas assez pour en perdre le contrôle.
fr.Martial law narrows every exit. I need a: La loi martiale restreint toutes les issues. J'ai besoin d'un itinéraire qui protège Woble sans révéler ce que sait notre camp.
fr.An agreement is useful only if its condi: Un accord n’est utile que si ses conditions peuvent être appliquées. J'écoute ce qui n'a pas été dit.
fr.Every quiet minute aboard this ship is b: Chaque minute tranquille à bord de ce navire est du temps emprunté. Je l'utilise pour garder Woble en vie.
fr.I cannot let fear choose for me. Whateve: Je ne peux pas laisser la peur choisir à ma place. Quoi qu’il arrive en dehors de cette pièce, l’enfant passe en premier.
fr.I do not want the throne. If an alliance: Je ne veux pas du trône. Si une alliance donne un jour de plus à l'enfant, j'en connaîtrai le prix.
fr.I am watching the door, even when Kurapi: Je surveille la porte, même lorsque Kurapika me dit de me reposer. Une mère à bord de ce navire ne peut pas se permettre de ne pas le faire.
fr.Order is not a request. Every corridor w: La commande n'est pas une demande. Chaque couloir répondra à mon ordre avant la fin de cette journée.
fr.A threat that shows itself has already m: Une menace qui se manifeste a déjà commis sa première erreur. Mes soldats veilleront à ce que ce soit le dernier.
fr.There is one throne and one chain of com: Il y a un trône et une chaîne de commandement. Le concours décide uniquement de la rapidité avec laquelle les autres acceptent ce fait.
fr.Report facts, not impressions. I will de: Rapportez des faits, pas des impressions. Je déciderai de ce qu'ils veulent dire.
fr.The throne is mine. Anyone treating that: Le trône est à moi. Quiconque traite cela comme une question perd le peu de temps qui lui reste.
fr.Let them try. Their hostility is far mor: Laissez-les essayer. Leur hostilité m'est bien plus utile que leur obéissance.
fr.I have given my order. I am not interest: J'ai donné ma commande. Je ne suis pas intéressé de savoir pourquoi quelqu’un n’a pas réussi à le mettre en œuvre.
fr.The structure is becoming clear. Once I: La structure devient claire. Une fois que j’ai compris la règle, l’amélioration n’est plus qu’une question de discipline.
La violence sans compréhension est grossière. Je préfère savoir exactement ce que l’autre personne pense qu’il va se passer.
fr.Do not interrupt. I am learning faster t: N'interrompez pas. J'apprends plus vite que les gens qui essaient de m'enseigner.
fr.A crown bought with the lives of my sibl: Une couronne achetée avec la vie de mes frères et sœurs n'est pas une légitimité. Je vais affronter le système qui l’exige.
fr.If we act, we act together. No single li: Si nous agissons, nous agissons ensemble. Aucune vie dans cette pièce n’est une munition à dépenser à la légère.
Leur confiance est plus lourde que n’importe quelle arme. J'ai l'intention d'en rester digne.
fr.The vessel does not ask which seed wishe: Le vaisseau ne demande pas quelle graine souhaite pousser. Il préserve celui qui est assez fort pour devenir l'arbre.
fr.Grief belongs to a father. The king must: Le chagrin appartient à un père. Le roi doit encore mener à bien le rituel.
fr.The voyage proceeds. What matters is not: Le voyage continue. Ce qui compte, ce n’est pas le bruit à bord, mais ce qui reste une fois terminé.
fr.Fear changes the heart before the face a: La peur change le cœur avant que le visage ne l'admette. Cette salle en dit déjà plus que ses mots.
fr.A path is only safe if both of them reac: Un chemin n’est sûr que si les deux arrivent à son terme. J'écouterai pour le moment où le plan commencera à échouer.
fr.Keep your voice steady. A lie is much lo: Gardez votre voix ferme. Un mensonge est beaucoup plus fort pour moi que vous ne le pensez.
fr.You are free to refuse. I only need you: Vous êtes libre de refuser. J’ai seulement besoin que vous compreniez ce que coûte réellement ce choix.
fr.Power makes the rules visible. What some: Le pouvoir rend visibles les règles. Ce que fait quelqu’un après l’avoir vu est la partie qui m’intéresse.
fr.This ship carries an entire country in m: Ce navire transporte un pays entier en miniature. Cela en fait un excellent endroit pour recommencer.
fr.Do not confuse speed with progress. We f: Ne confondez pas vitesse et progrès. Nous trouvons Hisoka en comprenant où il veut que nous regardions.
fr.Stay with the objective. Anger is useful: Restez avec l’objectif. La colère n’est utile que lorsqu’elle ne choisit pas la voie à notre place.
fr.The ship is a closed book with moving pa: Le navire est un livre fermé aux pages animées. Il nous suffit d'apprendre l'ordre dans lequel ils tournent.
fr.If they are looking for me, the least I: S’ils me recherchent, le moins que je puisse faire est de rendre la recherche amusante.
fr.The dangerous ones are finally moving. W: Les plus dangereux bougent enfin. Attendre commençait à devenir fastidieux.
fr.So many people are trying not to show th: Beaucoup de gens essaient de ne pas montrer leur main. C’est généralement à ce moment-là qu’ils sont le plus révélateurs.
fr.The order has changed. Hold the corridor: L'ordre a changé. Tenez le couloir, vérifiez chaque identité et ne laissez personne improviser.
fr.Someone found a way through the security: Quelqu'un a réussi à passer les contrôles de sécurité. Jusqu'à ce que nous sachions comment, chaque publication est compromise.
fr.Conventional security is not enough agai: La sécurité conventionnelle ne suffit pas face à une capacité que nous ne pouvons pas identifier. J'observe les comportements, pas les explications.
fr.The target is still unconfirmed. I keep: La cible n'est toujours pas confirmée. Je garde mon secteur fermé jusqu'à ce que le rapport change.
fr.An unguarded route is not an exit; it is: Une route non surveillée n’est pas une sortie ; c'est une brèche. Je le traite comme tel.
fr.They can talk. My responsibility is to m: Ils peuvent parler. Ma responsabilité est de m’assurer que personne ne modifie l’équilibre pendant qu’il le fait.
fr.The princes decide policy. My job is to: Les princes décident de la politique. Mon travail consiste à m'assurer que mon équipe soit toujours debout lorsqu'elle aura terminé.
fr.Stay behind the line and keep your hands: Restez derrière la ligne et gardez vos mains visibles. Je ne donnerai pas une seconde ouverture à la menace.
fr.I remain at my post. Quiet does not mean: Je reste à mon poste. Calme ne signifie pas sécurité à bord de ce navire.
fr.Authority is moving faster than the evid: L’autorité évolue plus vite que les preuves. J'ai besoin de préserver à la fois la scène et notre liberté d'agir.
fr.The method matters more than the panic a: La méthode compte plus que la panique qui l’entoure. Si je peux lire le schéma, je peux empêcher la prochaine mort.
fr.Do not name an ability before its condit: Ne nommez pas une capacité avant que ses conditions ne soient connues. Une hypothèse erronée est exactement ce qu'exploite un utilisateur de Nen.
fr.I am following confirmed movement, not r: Je suis des mouvements confirmés, pas des rumeurs. Sur un navire aussi bondé, cette distinction maintient les gens en vie.
fr.Every route has a condition. I want to k: Chaque itinéraire a une condition. Je veux savoir qui peut utiliser celui-ci et ce qui se passe une fois fermé.
fr.I will listen, but I will verify every c: J’écouterai, mais je vérifierai chaque condition avant que quiconque sous ma garde ne l’accepte.
fr.The contest turns every ordinary decisio: Le concours transforme chaque décision ordinaire en un geste. J'essaie d'empêcher les gens de devenir des morceaux.
fr.Stay alert and do not chase the first ex: Restez vigilant et ne courez pas après la première explication. La menace évidente n’est peut-être que le déclencheur.
fr.I am watching the room and the people wa: Je regarde la pièce et les gens qui la regardent. Les deux me disent quelque chose de différent.
fr.The army calls this protection. In a suc: L'armée appelle cela une protection. Dans une course à la succession, la protection consiste simplement à contrôler avec de meilleures manières.
fr.Another room is grieving, and every othe: Une autre pièce est en deuil, et toutes les autres pièces calculent ce que la mort change.
fr.The beasts have changed the contest, but: Les bêtes ont changé le concours, mais pas son objectif. Le pouvoir appartient toujours à celui qui comprend les règles en premier.
Laissez les niveaux inférieurs poursuivre leur proie. Ce qui m'intéresse davantage, c'est à qui profite la perturbation.
fr.A hidden passage is valuable only until: Un passage caché n’a de valeur que jusqu’à ce que tout le monde sache qu’il existe. Maintenant, c'est un levier.
fr.An alliance aboard this ship is not trus: Une alliance à bord de ce navire n'est pas synonyme de confiance. Il s’agit d’un accord selon lequel le danger passe en premier.
fr.Every prince is measuring the others. I: Chaque prince mesure les autres. J'ai l'intention de décider ce qu'ils sont autorisés à apprendre de moi.
La panique est une invitation à ses rivaux. Quoi qu’il arrive, cette salle restera composée.
fr.Nothing aboard is merely routine now. Ev: Plus rien à bord n’est désormais une routine. Même le silence entre les pièces a un poids politique.
fr.Uniforms are filling the corridors. Busi: Les uniformes remplissent les couloirs. Les affaires continuent, mais personne ne prend deux fois le chemin habituel.
fr.A body is a message. Before I react, I w: Un corps est un message. Avant de réagir, je veux savoir qui était censé le lire.
fr.Nen has changed the price of every mista: Nen a changé le prix de chaque erreur. Les personnes qui apprendront le plus rapidement seront propriétaires des itinéraires.
fr.Everyone is searching, which means every: Tout le monde cherche, ce qui veut dire que tout le monde laisse des traces. Cela vaut peut-être plus que l’objectif.
fr.A route nobody controls is a route waiti: Une route que personne ne contrôle est une route qui attend d'être revendiquée.
fr.Terms are temporary. What matters is who: Les conditions sont temporaires. Ce qui compte, c’est de savoir qui a encore des options une fois l’accord conclu.
fr.The princes fight above us, but every de: Les princes se battent au-dessus de nous, mais chaque décision qu’ils prennent modifie le marché en dessous.
fr.Keep the exits clear. Courage is cheaper: Gardez les sorties dégagées. Le courage coûte moins cher quand il y a encore un endroit où aller.
fr.I am listening. On this ship, useful inf: J'écoute. Sur ce navire, les informations utiles arrivent généralement avant celui qui les vend.
fr.There are more soldiers outside than bef: Il y a plus de soldats dehors qu’avant. Tout le monde me dit de ne pas m'inquiéter, ce qui rend difficile de ne pas le faire.
fr.The adults stop talking when I enter. I: Les adultes arrêtent de parler quand j'entre. Je sais que ça veut dire que quelque chose de terrible s'est produit.
fr.They say there is something in the room: Ils disent qu’il y a quelque chose dans la pièce que je ne peux pas voir. Je pense que certains d’entre eux ont plus peur que moi.
fr.Everyone keeps looking at the doors. I w: Tout le monde continue de regarder les portes. J'aimerais que quelqu'un me dise ce qu'il s'attend à vivre.
fr.If the door opens again, I want to know: Si la porte s'ouvre à nouveau, je veux savoir où elle va avant que quelqu'un ne me suive.
fr.They are speaking politely, but nobody i: Ils parlent poliment, mais personne dans la pièce ne semble calme.
fr.The adults call it a contest. Nobody loo: Les adultes appellent ça un concours. Personne n’a l’air de jouer.
fr.They told me to stay here and keep quiet: Ils m'ont dit de rester ici et de me taire. Je les entends bouger dehors.
fr.Everyone is busy, so I am trying not to: Tout le monde est occupé, alors j’essaie de ne pas devenir une chose de plus dont ils doivent s’inquiéter.
fr.The rules changed without warning. I wil: Les règles ont changé sans avertissement. Je garderai mes papiers d’identité à portée de main et je resterai à l’écart des soldats.
fr.News travels quickly aboard a closed shi: Les nouvelles circulent rapidement à bord d'un navire fermé. Ce n’est pas le cas de la vérité.
fr.They keep using the word Nen as though n: Ils continuent d’utiliser le mot Nen comme si nommer le danger permettait de survivre plus facilement.
fr.People are asking questions on every dec: Les gens posent des questions sur chaque pont. J'ai appris que la réponse la plus sûre est la plus courte.
fr.Every exit seems to lead to another chec: Chaque sortie semble mener à un autre point de contrôle. Je ne sais plus quelle direction compte comme sécurité.
fr.Important people are talking. The rest o: Des gens importants parlent. Le reste d’entre nous découvrira ce qu’ils ont décidé lorsque les portes s’ouvriront.
fr.The royal contest is far above my statio: Le combat royal est bien au-dessus de mon rang, mais ses conséquences continuent d'atteindre ce pont.
fr.I am staying close to the wall and away: Je reste près du mur et loin de toute personne qui semble savoir ce qui se passe.
fr.I am carrying on with my work. It is the: Je continue mon travail. C’est la seule chose ordinaire qui reste à faire.
fr.while the rule holds, Chain Jail is cert: tant que la règle est valable, Chaîne-prison est certain
fr.to break the oath is to pierce your own: rompre le serment, c'est transpercer son propre cœur

fr.Nothing draws this deck. Tier 1 is a lin: Aucun dessin ne donne ce pont. Le pont 1 est un paquebot et ses ponts sont les étages d'un même bâtiment : celui-ci est l'enveloppe de ce qu'il porte et du pont au-dessus, écrêtée à celui d'en dessous, parce qu'un plancher doit exister sous le plancher qui le surmonte. Quel bloc est à quel étage est le fait de la reconstruction et non une lecture.
fr.Nothing draws this deck. The cross-secti: Aucun dessin ne donne ce pont. La coupe qui nomme les ponts accroche les blocs du pont 3 à plusieurs hauteurs et non sur une seule rangée, et les cabines ordinaires y sont au-dessus du reste : cet ordre est tout ce qu’elle donne, donc le pont 3 est trois étages et celui-ci est celui du milieu. Sa coque est celle de son pont, et non l’enveloppe des salles qu’on y pose : la baleine garde sa forme à cette hauteur, et le reste du plancher est rempli de pièces que personne n’a dessinées. Une coque taillée sur ce qu’on sait creuserait une encoche dans le navire pour dire que la reconstruction y est mince. Là où rien n’est accroché, quel bloc est à quel étage est le fait de la reconstruction et non une lecture.

Il ne porte que le bloc accroché à cette hauteur : le pont existe, il ne porte presque rien, et c’est ce que le dessin montre. Sa coque est celle de son pont, et non l’enveloppe des salles qu’on y pose : la baleine garde sa forme à cette hauteur, et le reste du plancher est rempli de pièces que personne n’a dessinées. fr.Ch. 365 — Prince Zhang Lei's dining room: Chap. 365 — la salle à manger du prince Zhang Lei, où il reçoit la reine Oito : la longue table sculptée, un fauteuil à haut dossier à chacun de ses bouts, la crédence et la statue sur sa sellette le long du mur tribord, le cadre au mur et le guéridon près de la porte.
fr.Broad Party Bed: Large lit de la pièce de fête
fr.Chs. 366 and 382 — Salé-salé lies in wit: Chap. 366 et 382 — Salé-salé reste couché avec deux compagnes dans le large lit qui transforme sa chambre en pièce de fête informelle ; Predator et Stand By Me l'atteignent tous deux à côté de ce lit.
fr.Ch. 376 — Princess Kacho's kitchen, draw: Chap. 376 — la cuisine de la princesse Kacho, dessinée deux fois : le plan de travail sous ses éléments hauts, la plaque de cuisson avec sa casserole et le four encastré dessous, le retour de plan le long du mur tribord, et la rangée de placards bas sous les deux. Le morse de Senritsu en désigne un exactement — cuisine, placard de gauche, en bas, au fond.
fr.Ch. 376 — Prince Kacho's salon, where sh: Chap. 376 — le salon de la princesse Kacho, où on la fait asseoir sur ses devoirs : le mur lambrissé derrière elle et ses tableaux encadrés, sous le plafond à caissons commun aux appartements.
fr.Ch. 367 — the same network, one apartmen: Chap. 367 — le même réseau, un appartement plus loin : le cafard sort des égouts par la grille de la grande chambre du prince Momoze et surplombe le lit. C'est par cette grille que la reine Oito assiste au meurtre de Momoze au chap. 368.
fr.Ch. 367 — the sewer network under the re: Chap. 367 — le réseau d'égouts sous la zone d'habitation et les grilles à persiennes par lesquelles il débouche dans les appartements : le cafard de Bill est lâché dans les égouts et gagne ainsi un prince après l'autre. Les pièces du prince Marayam sont les premières qu'il observe d'en haut, juste sous le plafond.
fr.Ch. 371 — the dining room laid for the h: Chap. 371 — la salle à manger dressée pour la maison, où Kurapika arrête une servante entre les tables et lui pose ses deux questions : deux longues tables la traversent sous un plafond à caissons, couvertes de plateaux-repas, chaises à haut dossier le long de leurs côtés, et entre elles une allée où l'on sert. Le plan du chap. 363 n'y met qu'une petite table ; la planche, elle, montre la pièce.
fr.Ch. 382, pp. 29–30 — a monumental framed: Chap. 382, p. 29–30 — un tableau de bataille monumental domine le mur au-dessus du manteau ornementé.
fr.Ch. 382 — the King's living room: patter: Chap. 382 — le salon du Roi : sol à motifs, sièges appariés, tableaux encadrés et la baie du fond.
fr.Ch. 382, p. 29–30 — a long mantel below: Chap. 382, p. 29–30 — un long manteau sous le tableau de bataille monumental porte des photographies encadrées, des vases et un ornement central évoquant une horloge.
fr.Ch. 382, p. 29–30 — display furniture an: Chap. 382, p. 29–30 — des meubles d'exposition et objets ornementaux bordent les deux côtés du manteau central.
fr.Ch. 382, p. 29–30 — a tall narrow loudsp: Chap. 382, p. 29–30 — une grande enceinte étroite à trois haut-parleurs circulaires se dresse près du mur de tableaux bâbord.
fr.Ch. 382, p. 29–30 — bottles, glasses and: Chap. 382, p. 29–30 — bouteilles, verres et récipients couvrent une desserte drapée près du groupe de sièges du Roi.
fr.Ch. 413 — Halkenburg laid out in his fat: Chap. 413 — Halkenburg exposé dans le salon de son père, le Roi debout à son chevet.

fr.Chs. 379-380 — the Cha-R emblem is paint: Chap. 379-380 — l'emblème Cha-R est peint en panneau graphique sombre dans la salle principale.

fr.Chs. 379-380 — a plain wooden door compl: Chap. 379-380 — une porte en bois ordinaire complète les trois portes distinctes de la salle à l'emblème.
fr.Ch. 379, p. 16 — more than one stacked b: Chap. 379, p. 16 — plusieurs lits superposés sont visibles le long du mur du compartiment.

fr.Ch. 399, pp. 168-169 — the laundry/dispo: Chap. 399, p. 168-169 — la buanderie / salle d'élimination contient visiblement des machines industrielles frontales, éviers, rangements muraux, casiers, siphons, flexibles et au moins deux tables métalliques centrales.
fr.Ch. 399, pp. 170-175 — the communal room: Chap. 399, p. 170-175 — la salle commune contient visiblement la longue table et au moins huit chaises, des rangements muraux, une fontaine à eau et les réseaux apparents du plafond.
fr.Exposed Pipes and Cable Tray: Tuyaux et chemin de câbles apparents
fr.Ch. 407 — the large dark television and: Chap. 407 — le grand téléviseur sombre et son meuble bas occupent le mur derrière la chaise de bureau de Morena.
fr.Ch. 399, p. 3 — the side of a couch is v: Chap. 399, p. 3 — le flanc d’un canapé est visible contre le mur du bureau lorsque Hinrigh ouvre la porte de la planque ; le chap. 407 le montre en face de la table de Morena.
fr.Ch. 407 — a Famicom rests on the televis: Chap. 407 — une Famicom repose sur le meuble du téléviseur derrière Morena ; sa coque claire se détache de l’écran sombre.
fr.Ch. 407 — a Super Famicom sits beside th: Chap. 407 — une Super Famicom est posée à côté de la Famicom sur le meuble du téléviseur derrière Morena.
